youtube_title: Plow crews: the snow call comes the night before (Hard Hat Weather, LaPorte County)
youtube:
If you plow lots in LaPorte County, your winter starts at 6 PM, not 3 AM. ❄️ Hard Hat Weather texts you the evening before snow or ice: PLOW, SALT or WATCH for every lot you name, with the inches, the hours and the low. If it gets worse overnight, a 3 AM update. On a quiet night, no message at all. The morning after, each lot gets a dated record: how much fell, when, and what you were told, for per-push billing and the slip-and-fall question that comes in March. Free for one lot. A whole crew is $19 a month. Everything is free for 7 days, no card. Sign up before the first snow: https://laporteweathernow.com/hardhat #HardHatWeather #SnowPlow #SnowRemoval #LaPorte #MichiganCity #Indiana #Shorts

All pictures are drawn. The example text uses made-up forecasts. Snow totals come from NOAA's National Snowfall Analysis. Narration is a computer voice.
